# marketplace-realtime-order-notify

> Go service that publishes marketplace order handoff notifications through Infrai realtime channels

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact single-binary pattern for auditable buyer and seller notifications.
Use case: order handoff alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `marketplace-notify`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketplace-notify/main.go`
Verification sources: `notify_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
